glossary.definition: (1) "Ohio prisoner" means a person who is charged with or convicted of a crime in this state or who is alleged or found to be a delinquent child in this state.
glossary.source_title: Section 5120.64 - Rules regarding the return of Ohio prisoners from outside of this state into this state by a private person or entity.
